name: hr.mp4
title: Applied? Now message the HR
caption:
Applied to 301 jobs. 0 calls. 😶

The fix isn't applying more. It's what you do AFTER applying 👇
1️⃣ Apply on the portal
2️⃣ Find who posted it (LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, Wellfound)
3️⃣ Send 4 lines: "I just applied" + their name + one proof + one ask

No "Respected Sir, kindly consider my profile" 🙅

Comment HR and I'll DM you the prompt that writes it from your resume 🤖

#fresherjobs #linkedintips #jobsearchindia #placementprep #claudeai

name: intro.mp4
title: Tell me about yourself: stop reading your biodata
caption:
Your 'tell me about yourself' is just biodata 😶

Birthplace, parents' jobs, hobbies... the interviewer has heard it 500 times.

Use 3 parts, 60 seconds:
→ NOW: who you are today
→ PROOF: one thing you built, with a number
→ NEXT: why this role

Comment INTRO and I'll send you the prompt that writes it from your resume 🤖

#interviewtips #tellmeaboutyourself #fresherjobs #placementprep #claudeai

name: resume.mp4
title: 300 applications, 0 calls: the resume fix
caption:
300 applications on Naukri. Zero calls. 😩

The problem isn't you, it's sending the same resume 300 times.

Most companies use software (ATS) that reads your resume before any human does. It looks for words from the job post. No match = no call.

The fix, 2 minutes per job:
1️⃣ Paste the job post + your resume into Claude
2️⃣ Ask what's missing
3️⃣ Rewrite your points with real numbers
⚠️ Only true things. Never fake skills.

Follow @ai.jugaadd + comment RESUME and I'll DM you the exact prompt 📩

#resumetips #fresherjobs #naukri #jobsearchindia #claudeai
